premises.text: Honeybees are dying at an alarming rate due to pesticides, parasites, and diseases
premises.evidence_span: Every year, we lose about 40% of our bees because of pesticides, parasites, and diseases

premises.text: Beekeepers represent a $20 billion industry that is struggling to keep their bees alive
premises.evidence_span: the beekeepers, they represent a $20 billion industry in charge of honey production and pollening crops

premises.text: Beekeepers need to physically check each hive to monitor their health
premises.evidence_span: to get an idea of what's going on inside their hives, they have to physically go to every single one of them and open them up to look inside

premises.text: A beehive management platform using sensors and AI can help beekeepers monitor hive health remotely
premises.evidence_span: What if the bees could tell the beekeepers how to keep them healthy? At Nectar, that's what we provide them, a beehive management platform using sensors and AI

premises.text: Nectar translates hive data into an understandable interface for beekeepers
premises.evidence_span: we translate its temperature, humidity, sound frequencies, or really the signals that the bees send each other, the weight of the hive and its geolocation, and translate it into an interface understandable by us humans

premises.text: Affordable analytics can lead to more profitable apiaries for beekeepers
premises.evidence_span: We offer affordable analytics instead of expensive, raw data

premises.text: Nectar has validated its approach by connecting 100 hives and saving five hives from dying
premises.evidence_span: we've connected 100 hives, and a beautiful thing is that the product works, as we've been able to save five hives so far by detecting queen bee issues inside the hive

premises.text: The team at Nectar consists of beekeepers, designers, engineers, developers, and business people
premises.evidence_span: the team to bring you this is how we dress every day at the office. It's composed of beekeepers, of designers, engineers, developers, business people

value.text: Beekeepers can improve hive health and efficiency through technology
value.evidence_span: to promote our mission in empowering beekeepers, to provide sustainable and efficient pollination services

notes: Traction metrics and partnership discussions excluded as they do not represent premises.
